manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball rises, is still for an instant at the top, then falls. A motion arrow changes while the gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. The blue motion arrow shortens, vanishes at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow never changes.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top; press Play again to continue.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const g=9.8,u=inputs.launchSpeed;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(T,time));const ta=u/g;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const v=u-g*t;const ah=u*u/(2*g);const base=360,sc=40*5/1.3;const y=base-h*sc*0.5*1.3/1.3*1.0;const yy=base-h*60;const st=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004?1:(v>0?0:2);const objs=[...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:360,title:'Tossed ball',state:['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st]}),sdk.line('guide',60,base,300,base,{role:'neutral'}),sdk.text('guide.t',64,base+16,'Launch height',{}),sdk.circle('ball.toss',180,yy-14,28,{}),...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:240,y:yy},{value:Math.abs(v)<0.02?0:v,direction:'up'},{scale:14,label:'v',role:'input'}),...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:130,y:yy},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:5,label:'a',role:'warning'}),...sdk.callout(400,150,[['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st],'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'})];return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:objs,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st]},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:ah,velocity:v,height:h}};}
